**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the agreement.**

What I found:
- **Section 7 is headed "LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR"** but its three subsections contain only a mutual fees-paid liability cap (7(a)), a consequential-damages waiver (7(b)) and an attorneys'-fees waiver (7(c)). The heading promises an indemnity that the text never delivers.
- Document-wide searches for "indemn", "hold harmless" and "defend" return **no operative indemnity language at all** — so this is not a one-sided indemnity; it is a total absence.
- Section 5(c) does give Clear Capital an IP non-infringement warranty on the Works, but with no defence/indemnity obligation behind it, Clear Capital funds the defence of any third-party infringement claim itself and then must sue for breach of warranty, subject to the Section 7(a) fees-paid cap.
- Section 7(a)'s only cap carve-out points to "Paragraph 9," which is the Independent Contractor clause — further evidence the indemnity was dropped in drafting.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): inserted a new **Section 7(d)** after p0037 covering (i) IP infringement/misappropriation by the Services or Works, (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law, (iii) Contractor-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company Confidential Information or data, and (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct — using the document's own defined terms (Company, Contractor, Services, Works, Confidential Information). It includes standard notice/control/cooperation procedure with consent protection on settlements, and expressly carves the indemnity out of the Section 7(a)–(c) limitations, without which the fees-paid cap would hollow out the obligation.

No Customer-side indemnity exists, so nothing needed narrowing. The comment offers the fallback (customary IP exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, 3× annual fees super-cap) if RadialSpark resists an uncapped indemnity.
